# A call passed as an argument runs only when the request parsed: a path value
# that is not an int answers 400 without the nested method being called, as it
# does for a call at the top level.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "GET /article/{id} Show(ctx, Load(ctx, id))"}}{{with .Err}}failed: {{.}}{{else}}{{.Result}}{{end}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /pair/{id} Pair(ctx, Load(ctx, id), Load(ctx, id))"}}{{with .Err}}failed: {{.}}{{else}}{{.Result}}{{end}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /deep/{id} Show(ctx, Wrap(ctx, Load(ctx, id)))"}}{{with .Err}}failed: {{.}}{{else}}{{.Result}}{{end}}{{end}}
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

type Server struct{ loads *int }

func (s Server) Load(ctx context.Context, id int) (int, error) {
	*s.loads++
	return id * 10, nil
}

func (Server) Wrap(ctx context.Context, n int) (int, error) { return n + 1, nil }

func (Server) Show(ctx context.Context, n int) string { return fmt.Sprint("article ", n) }

func (Server) Pair(ctx context.Context, a, b int) string { return fmt.Sprint("pair ", a+b) }
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestNestedCalls(t *testing.T) {
	var loads int
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{loads: &loads})

	for _, tt := range []struct {
		target    string
		wantCode  int
		wantBody  string
		wantLoads int
	}{
		{"/article/7", http.StatusOK, "article 70", 1},
		{"/article/not-an-int", http.StatusBadRequest, "failed: ", 0},
		{"/pair/2", http.StatusOK, "pair 40", 2},
		{"/pair/not-an-int", http.StatusBadRequest, "failed: ", 0},
		{"/deep/3", http.StatusOK, "article 31", 1},
		{"/deep/not-an-int", http.StatusBadRequest, "failed: ", 0},
	} {
		loads = 0
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, tt.target, nil))
		if rec.Code != tt.wantCode {
			t.Errorf("GET %s status = %d, want %d", tt.target, rec.Code, tt.wantCode)
		}
		if !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), tt.wantBody) {
			t.Errorf("GET %s body = %q, want it to contain %q", tt.target, rec.Body.String(), tt.wantBody)
		}
		if loads != tt.wantLoads {
			t.Errorf("GET %s called Load %d times, want %d", tt.target, loads, tt.wantLoads)
		}
	}
}
